newsitem.title: UK: C&W names Graham Wallace CEO of new cable co.
newsitem.headline: C&W names Graham Wallace CEO of new cable co.

text.p: Britain's Cable & Wireless Plc said on Friday it named Graham Wallace as chief executive of its new Cable & Wireless Communications unit. Wallace will be joining the company from Granada Group Plc, where he is chief executive of the media and leisure firm's restaurants division, C&W said in a statement.

C&W chief executive Richard Brown will be chairman of the unit, set to be formed by the planned 5.0 billion pound ($8.36 billion) merger between four UK cable firms -- C&W's Mercury unit, Nynex Corp's NYNEX CableComms Group, Bell Cablemedia Plc, and Videotron Holdings Plc.
"I am delighted to announce Graham's appointment to head up the new company in the UK. He has an excellent track record of transforming businesses and delivering results," Brown said.
Wallace, 48, will join Cable & Wireless on February 1.
Granada said it named Don Davenport, currently managing director of its hospitality business, to succeed Wallace as head of the restaurants division.
